text: another bug: new cube -> cube (x7) -> toggle visiblity for all of them but 1 -> delete 1 face -> toggle visiblility for another -> delete a face -> toggle visiblity for some others -> undo -> undo -> undo -> face that was deleted is restored, all the other faces then turn translucent
resolution: Fixed undo after hide/show repacks restoring stale UV coordinates over a newer atlas. Journal snapshots now record the atlas layout revision; incompatible restores rebuild and carry raster pixels by authored face group, while compatible snapshots keep the exact raster/UV fast path. Added model-paint coordinate-revision coverage. Verified focused Zig tests, ReleaseFast editor build, and the exact eight-cube hide/delete/show/undo replay: Cube 1 remains at 10 triangles, Cube 2 restores to 12, six cubes remain hidden, and all 22 visible UV centroids sample alpha 255 (0 transparent, 0 glass vertices).
